messages:
Aisha - Recruiting: Quick scheduling note — Sam Patel's onsite loop is confirmed for Thu 8/22, 10:00–13:00 PT. candidate is in EST (would be 13:00–16:00 ET).
Ben - Eng Manager: Thanks. Which interviews are lined up?
Aisha - Recruiting: 10:00–10:35 intro + system design with Ben, 10:50–11:20 take-home walkthrough with Eva, 11:30–12:00 leadership + exec fit with me, 12:00–13:00 lunch debrief and offer conversation room (informal). Calendar invites sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
Eva - SWE: Got it. Can someone drop the Zoom link in thread? I may be remote that day.
Aisha - Recruiting: Zoom link is in the invites but pasting here for convenience: https://zoom.us/j/999999999?pwd=XYZ
Jared - People Ops: Facilities note — please reserve Conf Room C (Campus 3, 3rd floor) for 10:00–13:30 in case we run over. facilities-bot will create badge request.
facilities-bot: Visitor badge request created for Sam Patel for Thu 8/22; pickup at Security Desk. Badge ID: VIS-8421.
Ben - Eng Manager: ETA for candidate arrival? We should have ~10 minutes buffer before 10:00 to grab coffee/settle.
Aisha - Recruiting: Candidate arriving 09:40 PT per candidate email. I asked for ID and building entry instructions; they confirmed they can bring a driver's license.
Eva - SWE: I'll prep the take-home rubric — can someone upload the rubric template to the interview thread?
Aisha - Recruiting: Uploaded rubric: /docs/interviews/takehome-rubric-v2.pdf. Please focus on clarity of design, tradeoffs, and testing approach.
Ben - Eng Manager: Noted. Also pls remind the candidate about parking — are we covering parking reimbursement?
Jared - People Ops: Yes, we cover up to $20 parking or rideshare for onsite interviews. Candidate was emailed the reimbursement form; link: https://redwoodinference.com/reimburse-form
Aisha - Recruiting: Candidate mentioned dietary restriction: vegetarian. Lunch order will be veggie sandwiches.
Eva - SWE: Awesome. One accessibility check — candidate asked if we can provide a quiet room for a quick warm-up before the loop. Can we arrange that?
Jared - People Ops: Yes — Conf Room B is reserved 09:30–09:50 PT for candidate warm-up. I'll add it to the calendar.
Ben - Eng Manager: For interviewers joining remotely, please join 5 min early to test audio/screen share.
Aisha - Recruiting: Small logistics: badge pick-up is at lobby Security Desk (bring ID), building entrance on 4th Ave. Post-interview escort to transit is available on request.
Eva - SWE: Thanks. I'll join remote — anyone on-site who can run the video/room tech if needed?
Ben - Eng Manager: I'll be on-site and can help with A/V.
Aisha - Recruiting: One more: candidate asked if we can accommodate a slightly later start if their commute runs long. If they run late we'll shift interviews by up to 30 mins; please confirm availability.
Ben - Eng Manager: I can shift up to 20 mins, 30 is tight but probably doable if lunch moves.
Eva - SWE: I can shift.
Jared - People Ops: Facilities confirmed room availability until 2:00 PT. We're covered.
Aisha - Recruiting: Perfect. I'll DM candidate with backup time 10:30 start option and confirm today.
calendar-bot: Event updated: "Sam Patel — Onsite Loop" — invites adjusted for time-zone, rooms and Zoom attached.
Aisha - Recruiting: Update — candidate requested a 10:30 start. They said "I hit traffic sometimes, 10:30 would be much safer." Shall we accept?
Ben - Eng Manager: Accept. Please push the calendar invites and note the 10:30 start in the event description.
Eva - SWE: Accepted. I'll be there.
Aisha - Recruiting: Done — invites updated to 10:30–13:30 PT (buffer added). I also updated the event with lunch dietary notes and reimbursement link.
Jared - People Ops: Heads up to interviewers: post-interview please submit feedback within 48 hours in Greenhouse. Reminder email will go out automatically.
Ben - Eng Manager: Thanks — will do.
Aisha - Recruiting: Thanks everyone. I'll post a final logistics message on the morning of the interview with the exact Zoom passcode and security badge number.
Ben - Eng Manager: :thumbsup:
